offers_products.reason: Designs and manufactures engineered bearings, power transmission products, lubrication systems and industrial motion systems.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is mainly manufactured bearings and motion products; repair and rebuild services are a minor side line.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells bearings and drives to industrial OEMs, distributors and end users, not to households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to OEMs, industrial distributors and aerospace, defense, energy and automation manufacturers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Bearings and parts are repeat-ordered by OEMs and distributors, with large aftermarket and replacement demand.

cyclical_demand.reason: Industrial bearings demand follows manufacturing and capital equipment cycles; customers cut orders in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Bearings and components are small, frequently ordered items, though some integrated systems cost more.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured bearings and engineered motion products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers include many distributors and mid-sized industrial buyers alongside large OEMs, so the mix is broad.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs a global network of manufacturing plants that needs ongoing capital investment.

notes: The large_customers answer is a judgment call: customers are both large OEMs and many distributors.
